name: Cato Networks
note: Technology partner of the Porsche Formula E Team. Left unrated: Cato Networks' investors include Singtel Innov8, the corporate venture fund of Singtel (innov8.singtel.com), in which Singapore's state fund Temasek holds just over 50% (The Edge Singapore, 2025, via https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/capital-group-emerges-substantial-singtel-002056508.html), and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Neither stake is published. Singapore counts as a state with a record in this data, so an effective Temasek stake of 5% or more (Singtel Innov8 would need about 10% of Cato), or a board seat, would be Concern. No human-rights finding against the company located.
